sources.snippet: Ling is a MoE LLM provided and open-sourced by InclusionAI. We introduce two different sizes, which are Ling-lite and Ling-plus. Ling-lite has 16.8 billion parameters with 2.75 billion activated parameters, while Ling-plus has 290 billion parameters with 28.8 billion activated parameters. sources.snippet: Ling-3.0-tiny Ling-3.0-tiny is a lightweight hybrid reasoning model in the Ling series designed for edge deployment scenarios, with 7.9B total parameters and only 1.3B activated parameters.

sources.snippet: Ling-3.0-tiny is an efficient 7.9B-parameter MoE model with only 1.3B active parameters per token. It is designed for responsive AI agents, reliable instruction following, and natural multi-turn conversations. sources.title: Ling 3.0 Tiny Review: Ant Group's 7.9B MoE Model (August 2026)
sources.snippet: Ling 3.0 Tiny is a 7.9-billion-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model from InclusionAI, Ant Group's AI research division, released on 6 August 2026. It activates only around 1.3 billion parameters per token, ships with a native 256K-token context window, switchable Thinking and Instant reasoning modes, native function calling, and prompt caching.
